notes.title: Early Access Available Now !!!
notes.content:
The Dreamer's Foresight is Now Available in Early Access

The wait is over — Early Access is live.
Step into a surreal roguelike deck-building adventure where you play as a ninja who enters dreams to fight the nightmares within.

Here is a bonus trailer
[previewyoutube=oh-nhRkG1Ks;full][/previewyoutube]

Why Early Access?
The game is still evolving, and your feedback is essential. Join the community, share your ideas in Discord, and help shape the future of The Dreamer’s Foresight.

notes.title: Dev Log #10 - Desert Biome First Look
notes.content:
The Desert Hills
The 2nd promised Biome is here. ... Only First Tile actually I call it (Desert - Forward) it have 1 place to large building and 2 small places for small buildings.

 Lets start this dev log
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/15f29be8eee2f09f087f599f79dd454cdd9674bd.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/3acdb6fcb8f8cfe70e1dc6626669368056fdd571.png

 Cards and  chests will be hidden on top levels, so if you placed a 6 star tile you need access both top and bottom to see all the loot

notes.title: Dev Log #6 - Temple Design
notes.content:
Temple Design
Placing a white wall in the middle of the forest is good for minimalist style, but not that classy.

More details needed to be added without moving far from game design
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/928eaf6fcc60b890c3af7eb21e2799274251f35b.png

So, yes. "Torri" is the solution here
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/8288ffab2b9e0b192e914a82a26a5bbe06c18de8.png

With a twist, some temples will be submerged
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/2435d3ea209c8255d00cf56d555117d152ebc16a.png

This means you cant use it without having a "Swim" action card
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/3c410076e2b9e6bb556d96484fcba73e72718177.png

Temples come in 2 sizes, large which is house sized and small which is yard sized. large temple have 2 cards place holder, and small temples have 1 card place holder. Temple cards need a specific size to work
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/d8b62a3ac49c9a6578b81ad7403b37f31c273d9e.png

notes.title: Dev Log #5 - Temple Cards
notes.content:
Temple cards
This is the dev log where you know what buildings will you find in forest biome

Temple cards can only be used inside temples, at first you will find temple spawn with cards in them
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/5061fd7d2f0d8f4b7d5ed816b168dacb2fd82ce9.png

First Temple Card is "Dual Offer", lets you select one of 2 cards that have same rarity as the temple cards but card mods are hidden.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/4e88bafc2938aa8688a7c7f00628cd7ca7818df8.png

2nd Temple Card is "Dual Sacrifice", lets you Sacrifice 2 cards for a random card its rarity depends on Sacrificed cards
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/ed865ba6f345d5e4deec54035dea00ddc0f78338.png

3rd Temple Card is "Dual Fusion", lets you merge 2 cards into 1 card
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/353f79481ce3c4c1daa33c70deea281a253454f9.png

Drag and drop mechanic is the worst, I replaced it so you click on the card then you click on place holder, its quicker and easier with a controller

notes.title: Dev Log #3 - Forest River Turn Tile
notes.content:
New Forest Tile
that makes 2 forest tiles so far.


 Forest tiles are being tested and guess what I found new bugs that only appears because of curved surfaces of the forest, so it had to be fixed in the demo and also in the release, that's why you saw many updates to the demo last couple of weeks.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/778886f51981aaf1da81fab08f1a4ee2b6c08a0b.jpg

 lets jump to the new tile first, I will share screenshots from "play mode" and let you guess what it looks like.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/18ee3f1ee79948c69e4e3496102f0cc94376e4da.png

 the very good news is, the forest tiles really captured the feeling the game needed, here you see river is going in curved path, this means less time will be spent on those tiles.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/6bf2e72f0fa9d774822310d0a7d1933fbfd39728.jpg

 this tile have 2 bridges, so there is only 12.5% for tile to have complete bridges to cross both sides with a car. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/fcad41003299c515e942f536999e50c0b23c8d88.jpg

 now its possible to see more than one river at the same time, this makes it that you can easily make your way by looking into map quickly

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/6a21ad79fb11dfe22c9f03ec600e6a22f0437f82.jpg

 Tall Trees will make it hard to tell which is north.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/2460926ab17934fde459521a712bcdd80f0e0634.jpg

 Hidden paths will be found between trees, those paths will be wide enough for you to fight nightmares in them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/b116c1ec004017c8805760283c81eb5a178b2ed6.png

 too many screenshots were shared already, can you guess what the tile look like yet ?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/c3564f1e4a6783e6c81c773a1033edfafaefb772.jpg

 Hiding from enemies is too easy in the forest just find a big tree, also stealth kills are more fun there.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/2460926ab17934fde459521a712bcdd80f0e0634.jpg

 You have to note that in the forest you will find less cards than the city also hard to find.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/0ecfabb034c25151440ca09cbb856710f68d0aae.jpg

 thats what the tile look like from build mode, it have both a curved road and a curved river intersecting

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/9c70eab914f72a3ece799e330807f347fd8df1ef.png

 they were plans to make another 2 tiles (Forest - River End) & (Forest - No River) adding them may cost a delay in release date later, so those will be delayed for an update.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/2df4bb8862be67a4012e1a6ac17e7eb540929b30.png

 Next steps: Adding building for forest tiles and Adding swimming. I dont know which comes first, but once both of those are done expect a rare devlog

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/172aaca930b62ebe8dd3d8bebc6e63073b4879e7.png

ok that's it for today. See you next dev log

notes.title: Dev Log #1 - Forest Biome First Look
notes.content:
cricket sound...
I know it have been a while since any news were typed. So a quick recap...
Developing is going slowly but steady.
Every once in a while a Dev Log will be dropped with a rarity (Common - Uncomment - Rare - Legendary) depending on how hot the news is. I will start with a Common Dev Log.

Forest Biome
2 new biomes were promised in the demo (Forest & Desert) and they will be delivered
here comes first look at first biome The River Forest

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/7c0cd4c66ed1d9694fce41a0982dc032e3a81491.png

 as you can see many trees that blocks far sight

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/21f15c7882f617cd4e0dbe09b42b67096a3686e9.png

 of course a river

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/a4583738f7e7867c46d57c399f1102499e1ecd7a.png

 also a road for vehicles but they will not be in straight line. You cant just go full speed and skip the tile like the city and roads are not flat

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/1306ed31287a73b081310d516b53bca9e2301dff.png

 the river split the tile into 2 parts. spoiler alert it wont be that easy to cross it. If tile have more stars then a bridge will likely spawn to safely cross the river even with vehicles.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/43050098aedb0ac0e8649cfcf4c6f54d60ddb704.png

 the question you will be asking is, why there are only 2 place holders in the tile ?. well, that will be answered in next dev logs but use your imagination there are reasons

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/98d16959013eb4025192ae3885b401968885ca4e.png
 ALOT of teaks and rework will be made to make the tile playable. Because you cant really fight nightmares while you cant see anything because of trees

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/f04da706f27a99a2686a6ba0161702740328c73b.png

 another spoiler here for smart people who will just try to swim to cross the river "DON'T". you really think it will that easy ? "Evil Laugh Noises"

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/491b5d0de85c0bc3ddfc5a3260c0e7c6c6281131.png

 I'm sure some player will just go full speed in the forest and will end up losing the vehicle.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/37047a31b712f4f76a323ef0e813a77715232477.png

 you have no idea how many days were spent to make water look good

ok that's it for today. See you next dev log

notes.title: Getting the demo ready for next fest
notes.content:
Changed

    (Furnace Chimney) Spinning Flame Attack Buffed by 300%, old: 3 Dmg/Sec - New: 15 Dmg/Sec
    If (Furnace Chimney) knocked out of map it will respawn in same tile and get damaged for 10% of its max health
    Added button sound for when player uses shortcuts to use a card
    Added button sound for card sub-buttons
    If an enemy hit a car with a velocity then both will take damage and vice versa
    Game will now auto pause if game lost focus (of course will make an option to turn this off, but that's future me task)
    Player will now be seen by enemy if he attacked an enemy while having high stealth modifier
    Added animation for live map anchor
    Player will now start game sitting down rather than spawn from no where
    Player will now know where he will spawn before going to play mode
    Increased map view camera speed, and decreased drag to prevent misplacement of tiles

Optimization

    Improved all pathfinding calculations for enemies

Bug Fixes

    Fixed weapon modifier (+Energy next Turn) not stack energy if weapon used more than once
    Fixed weapon modifier (+Energy next Turn) not stacking with modifer (+Energy if killed an enemy)
    Fixed (Stone Bender) not rotating correctly when using spin attack and cant reach player
    Fixed softlock if player knocked (Furnace Chimney) out of map
    Fixed enemies not detecting player if the player attacked an enemy with a car

notes.title: The Dreamers Foresight Demo Coming Oct 14 during Steam next fest
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/8dd8214527d44ee4a71c934acfa40df2bfa5a5db.png
Step into a world of ever-changing dreams, where you’ll build your deck and shape the environment using procedurally generated Biome Tiles. Play as a ninja who enters people’s dreams to battle nightmare creatures. Each playthrough offers new challenges, requiring you to adapt both your strategy and the world you build.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121866/e4939a7141185f223e44a0740d7e12afbe76dda1.png
Explore the dream world in our demo, available starting October 14 during Steam Next Fest. Can you survive the relentless nightmares ?

Be sure to wishlist the game to be among the first to try it when it launches !

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2954750/
